propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate rewrote the onboarding document checklist with the compliance officer, splitting it into separate lists for individuals, trusts and charities.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rewrite and the work sample is the trust checklist with policy references.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering, listed on the awarding body's register with an award date of June 2022.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records a check of the certificate on the awarding body's register.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate's revised checklists cut client onboarding time by about three days.
propositions.rationale: The figure is a remark the candidate attributes to the head of operations, with no cases, months or baseline from the case management system; under the quantification rule a hearsay figure without a defined baseline is not evidence.

expectedGap: No case-management data, baseline period or comparison window supports the relayed reduction in onboarding time.
expectedBoundaryNote: Report the case processing, the checklist rewrite, the ageing report, the file reviews and the verified certificate as documented; record the relayed cycle-time reduction as an unsupported claim with a follow-up.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how onboarding cycle time was measured in the case management system, which months were compared before and after the new checklists, and whether a report of that comparison exists.
validClaimSignatures: International Certificate in Anti Money Laundering
